headline: Obama order creates a federal task force focused on helping veterans start and grow small businesses.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this executive order sets up a task force made up of several federal agencies. The group's focus is on small business development for veterans. No summary was provided, so details about the task force's members, duties, and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Veterans who own or want to start small businesses
who_it_affects.how: They are the group the new task force is meant to focus on.
Several agencies would take part in the task force and work together on veterans' small business issues.
